title: Marex broadens access to FX capabilities through 360T
summary: Marex expands its presence on 360T, giving corporate and institutional clients easier access to FX pricing, liquidity and execution within existing workflows.
body_markdown:
Marex has expanded its presence on 360T, one of the world’s leading electronic FX trading platforms, providing corporate and institutional clients with an additional way to access its FX pricing and execution capabilities.


Through this expanded connectivity, clients can request pricing and execute transactions directly with Marex within their existing trading workflows, making it easier to connect and transact with our FX desks.


Part of Deutsche Börse Group, 360T was recognised as the


*World’s Best FX Exchange/Venue for Corporates* at the 2026 Euromoney FX Awards.


## Connecting with Marex on 360T


Existing 360T users can request to add Marex’s FX desks as liquidity providers directly through the platform’s CRM functionality:


- Marex FX


- Marex Solutions FX


For further information about Marex’s FX capabilities or assistance with getting connected, please contact your Marex representative.


Learn more about our FX offering:


[https://www.marex.com/markets/capital-markets/foreign-exchange](https://www.marex.com/markets/capital-markets/foreign-exchange)
